assessments.reasoning: Within the scope of a valid nested declaration that reuses an enclosing name, an unqualified reference selects the inner entity. The text requires qualification to reach the hidden entity and describes this form of shadowing as implicit.

challenge.method: Compare lookup in the method declaring a local with lookup in a sibling method of the same class.
challenge.results: Only the former method's local hides the field. The sibling can still use the field's simple name. The example requires neither inheritance nor competing imports.

limitations: The finding concerns shadowing through nesting, separate from shadowing through inheritance or ambiguity between imported names.
